revision_summary: One quote-timestamp fix required: in script_coverage[6] (bill_amount), the customer bill quote 'My average energy bill is, you know, like, it doesn't get any higher than $60 in the that's the winter.' is anchored to ts 00:57, but 00:57 is the rep's line ('Well, does the bill swap bill?'). The actual customer quote spans approximately 01:11–01:20. Update the ts field in script_coverage[6] to 01:11 (or 01:11-01:20 range) to match where the customer actually says it — note that bill_anchor_audit and cherry_pick_moments[3] already use the correct ~01:16 timestamp for the same quote, so this is an isolated inconsistency within script_coverage. Optionally, strengthen the objection_inversion_miss coaching point (cherry_pick_moments[4] / objections[1]) by adding the customer's direct pushback at 01:28 ('Well, but there's payment over time. Right?') as supporting evidence that the rep's no-upfront-cost line failed to land — this is a minor enhancement, not a blocking issue. Everything else in the analysis (rep intent read, trajectory verdict, missed prior-contact probing, unanchored soft exit, bill flip miss, outcome tag) is well-grounded in the transcript and schema."
